llm_fields.description: The scheme provides financial incentives of ₹3 lakh for men and ₹5 lakh for women from Devadasi families who are married couples, subject to income and caste eligibility criteria.
llm_fields.eligibility: Applicants must be residents of Karnataka, belong to the Scheduled Caste community, have a family income not exceeding Rs 5 lakh per annum, and apply within 18 months of marriage.
